sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Friday this tab went 2-1. Today: two college football picks and one NBA pick where two sources agree and none disagree.

straight.reasoning: SportsBettingDime and a second Rivalry Saturday column both take Oregon. The Ducks need this win to reach the Big Ten title game, have won their last three by 38, 24 and 13, and are 8-3 at home. Washington is on a short week after an emotional overtime upset of Indiana, and its last three games were all decided by 7 or fewer. Playable to -14; skip at -14.5.

CBS Sports' SportsLine model has Arizona covering in over 70% of simulations and winning by three touchdowns, and the Rivalry Saturday column also takes Arizona. The Wildcats are top-five in the Big 12 in scoring offense and defense, and Arizona State's offense ranks near the bottom of the conference. Lines range from -7.5 to -9.5 at different books; take the lowest number you can find. Playable to -9.5.

Dimers' top NBA pick (55% to cover) and BettingPros also takes Philly. The 76ers beat Indiana 111-87 last night without Jaylen Brown, are 2-1 on the second night of back-to-backs, and Houston's recent wins have come against losing teams. Some books have +11.5; take +12.5 if you can. Playable to +11.5.
